svg.font-family: JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
svg.aria-label: A floating waybar whose purple clock says free until 15:00, then names the next meeting: Standup in 27m. A click opens the Timetable drawer out of the clock: Chicago, EET and GMT side by side, Standup next with Join on workspace 2 and Copy link, the day strip with its events, dashed free gaps and a red now line, and a focus block sized to the gap before Standup. Starting it turns the clock green, counting down from 25:00. Later the clock goes amber at Standup in 2m, then red with Standup · Join at 15:00, and a middle-click switches to the meeting on workspace 2.
